node.statement: Final datum assembly with explicit prerequisites. Require validated node 1.5.3.1 for bijectivity, fixed amplifications, diagonal-unit error, and two-sided norm control; validated node 1.5.1 for exact involution compatibility and the d-comparison; and validated node 1.5.2 for compressed-product defect at most 5(C_H+kappa)e. The target elements P_1=P and P_2=Q are delta-projections by the root hypotheses and ||P_1+P_2-I||<=delta<=e<=D_0*e, where D_0=5(C_H+kappa) after enlarging universal constants so D_0>=1. Thus, with rho=D_0*e, every clause of the amended def-four-corner-merging-datum holds for the four fixed level-one maps gamma_jk and all their amplifications. No conclusion of this child is available until all three declared dependencies are validated.
